description.value: Belgard Kitchen is a full-service restaurant in Vancouver's Railtown Design District, just east of Gastown, highlighting Canadian ingredients from coast to coast with globally influenced techniques and a drink menu centred on BC wines and craft beer. It operates lunch on weekdays, brunch on weekends, happy hour, and dinner seven nights a week, with private dining spaces available in the Mezzanine and Cellar venues. The same hospitality group runs sister restaurants Havana Vancouver, The Flamingo Room, and Violeté.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands at 42m; stands at 43m; stands at 46m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details (address, phone, website). Menu pages explicitly label items with dietary tags (vg, v, gf, df), confirming vegetarian/vegan/GF options; a dedicated takeout section and phone number confirm takeout availability. No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging, so those remain null per the evidence-only rule.
concerns: No mention of bike parking, bike racks, or bike-friendly infrastructure anywhere on the website — the primary WWC required criterion for this category cannot be confirmed.
OSM email (info@belgardkitchen.com) is the general inbox; the contact page also lists reservations@belgardkitchen.com for bookings — minor discrepancy, both appear legitimate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Belgard Kitchen is a well-established, active restaurant with takeout and dietary options useful to cyclists, but no evidence of bike parking was found in the website content, which is the primary WWC required criterion for a Food & Drink listing. A site visit or follow-up is needed to confirm whether bike parking exists before including.
enrichment_extras.notes: Restaurant is clearly active: upcoming events listed through June 2026 and a dated fresh sheet (May 25–29) confirm current operation. Located in the Railtown Design District, a neighbourhood with significant cycling infrastructure, so bike parking may exist nearby even if not mentioned on the website.
